summary: First Mining Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K on May 19, 2026, disclosing assay results from its 2025 exploration drilling program at the Duparquet Gold Project in Quebec. The press release highlights high-grade gold intercepts from the North Zone, South Zone, and Minuit targets, including DUP25-056 returning 15.14 g/t Au over 5.0 m. This is a routine operational update on exploration progress, not a special situation. The filing contains no terms, bids, offers, or structural changes. Investors should await the 2026 drilling program plans for further news.
